documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Intimation About Receipt Of Approval For Enhancement In Manufacturing Capacity Of Ethanol Plant
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY 2025-26 with a 62.55% increase in revenue from operations and a 97.60% growth in net profit compared to the previous financial year. The newly commissioned 150 KL per day grain-based ethanol plant successfully operated for the full year, significantly contributing to the company's financial results. The board decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year. Key headwinds noted include global geopolitical tensions, volatility in crude-derived raw material prices, and foreign exchange fluctuations between USD and INR. Pasupati Acrylon reported an 8.03% increase in revenue from operations to Rs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received consents from respective departments to enhance ethanol plant capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequently, the Company had filed an application with the concerned departments to enhance the capacity from 150 KL per day to 180 KL per day due to improve operational efficiency and the Company has received the consents from the respective departments/ authorities in this regard.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the ethanol plant was assessed at Rs. 167 crore, and the company has spent around Rs. 188 crore so far.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost was assessed Rs. 167 Crore (excluding working capital margin) but the project was overrun due to Civil work. Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the total cost of the proposed ethanol project is Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that Indian Bank had sanctioned a term loan of Rs. 108 crores for the ethanol project.
capex_expansion.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the company has spent around Rs. 92.17 crore so far on the ethanol project.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and balance amount out of internal accruals.

margins_costs.claim: Various cost optimisation measures led to significant savings during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Various cost optimisation driven by way of alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements and operational efficiency improvements has led significant savings.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 8.03% to Rs. 62,143.18 lakh for the financial year 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from Operations stood at Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh as against Rs. 57,522.82 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing an increase of 8.03% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: EBIDTA for the financial year 2024-25 was Rs. 5,620.09 lakh, representing an increase of 109.31% over the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIDTA was Rs. 5,620.09 Lakh as against Rs. 2,684.93 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing an increase of 109.31% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the financial year 2024-25 grew by 168.24% to Rs. 3,538.12 lakh.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after Tax was Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh as against Rs. 1,318.99 Lakh in the previous financial year, representing a growth of 168.24% over the corresponding period of last financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that loss of the CPP segment is incurred due to persistent fall in selling prices from excessive production capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Loss of CPP segment is incurred during the year caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

capital_allocation.claim: During the year under review, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2025-26.

capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, your Company has neither accepted nor renewed any deposits within the meaning of Section 73 of the Companies Act, 2013 and the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014.

capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the board decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24 as internal accruals are being utilized to set-up the ethanol plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global acrylic fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global Acrylic Fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fluctuation in crude affects raw material prices, and crude prices remained volatile due to US/Israel-Iran and Russia-Ukraine wars.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in US/Israel-Iran War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Since the company is dependent upon imports, fluctuation in foreign exchange between USD and INR has a bearing on margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The market for CPP film is moderately competitive due to the presence of multiple vendors.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, the market for CPP Film is moderately competitive owing to the presence of multiple vendors in the market.

risks_headwinds.claim: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies and the company has no control over them.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Crude prices remained volatile due to the conflict in the Israel-Hamas War and Russia-Ukraine War.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that revenue and net profit declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative returns on the CPP segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Revenue and Net profit during the year declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted several challenges including crude price volatility, raw material price fluctuations, dumping of acrylic fibre by China, Thailand and Belarus, and foreign exchange fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite various challenges such as volatility in crude prices and raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by China, Thailand and Belarus, foreign exchange fluctuations, the Company is focused on improvement in its revenue and net profit.

management_commitments.claim: The company is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has exported to Algeria, Kenya, Peru, Ukraine, Morocco, Tunisia, Ethiopia, Nepal etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company is expected to commence commercial production of ethanol by September, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.
